source: OBSERVED — de-identified lookup usage, k-anonymity suppressed
note: Built from de-identified lookup records (category, tract, travel times only — no addresses). Tracts with fewer than k lookups are suppressed, fail-closed, and each published statistic must itself rest on at least k observations. Categories with fewer than k lookups are omitted entirely (listing them would disclose that 1..k-1 people searched them). Counts are coarsened so suppressed totals cannot be recovered by subtraction. See docs/privacy-design.md.
